name: FFS_CHAT_PARTICIPANT
description: Used to store participants taking part in Collaboration chats.

columns.name: CHAT_ID
columns.description: Chat id for this chat participant.

columns.name: INVITED_BY
columns.description: Id of the user who invited this participant to the chat.

columns.name: INVITED_TIME
columns.description: Time at which this participant is invited to the chat.

columns.name: LEFT_TIME
columns.description: Time at which this participant left the chat.

columns.name: PART_TYPE
columns.description: Type of participant : user or bot. Value is : user -> 0, bot -> 1.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CHAT_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: Contains unique identifier of the row. System generated.

columns.name: LAST_READ_MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Reference to the last message read by the participant in this chat.

columns.name: LAST_READ_TIME
columns.description: Time when the participant last read messages in this chat.
